title: Far from the Crowd: Scalable Self-Supervised Learning via Geographic Isolation
abstract: arXiv:2608.19766v1 Announce Type: cross  Abstract: Self-supervised pretraining on remote sensing imagery typically treats all samples as equally informative, despite large variability in geographic and visual structure. We propose a curriculum learning strategy for self-supervised Earth observation that ranks samples by geographic isolation, a label-free proxy derived entirely from geolocation metadata already present in geospatial datasets, requiring no image decoding, no model feedback, and no manual annotation. Unlike visual complexity proxies, it scales as O(D log D) with dataset size D and is well-defined for both contrastive and reconstructive objectives. We integrate the proposed measure into MoCoV2 and MAE pretraining and evaluate across three downstream tasks from CopernicusBench (BigEarthNet, DFC-2020, LCZ). Our curriculum reaches baseline final-epoch performance using as few as 20% of the training budget (MAE) and at most 40% (MoCo) of the training budget, and improves final

translated_title: 远离人群：基于地理隔离的可扩展自监督学习
translated_abstract: 摘要：arXiv:2608.19766v1 公告类型：交叉 摘要：在遥感图像的自监督预训练中，通常将所有样本视为同等信息量，尽管它们在地理和视觉结构上存在巨大差异。我们提出了一种用于自监督地球观测的课程学习策略，该策略根据地理隔离程度对样本进行排序，这是一种完全由地理空间数据集中已有的地理定位元数据派生的无标签代理指标，无需图像解码、无需模型反馈、也无需人工标注。与视觉复杂性代理不同，它随数据集大小D以O(D log D)的复杂度扩展，并且对于对比学习和重建学习目标都适用。我们将所提出的度量整合到MoCoV2和MAE预训练中，并在来自CopernicusBench的三个下游任务（BigEarthNet、DFC-2020、LCZ）上进行评估。我们的课程学习在仅使用20%的训练预算（MAE）和最多40%的训练预算（MoCo）时即可达到基线的最终轮次性能，并提高了最终性能。
tldr: 提出了一种基于地理隔离的无标签课程学习策略，通过仅利用地理定位元数据对遥感样本排序，在不增加额外开销的情况下显著减少训练预算并提升自监督预训练性能。
en_tdlr: A curriculum learning strategy based on geographic isolation ranks remote sensing samples using only geolocation metadata, reducing training budget to as low as 20% while improving downstream performance.
